units.source_text: “他的体质像个发育不健全的孩子，连腿肚子都几乎没有肉呀。

en.t: His constitution is like that of a child who has not developed properly; even his calves have almost no flesh on them.

units.source_text: 按这种体质，恐怕连运动身体的力气都没有。

en.t: With a constitution like that, he probably does not even have the strength to move his body.

units.source_text: 也不能让他服用成年人的药量，只能服用十三四岁孩子的剂量，不然……”

en.t: Nor can we give him an adult dose of medicine; he can only take the dose for a thirteen- or fourteen-year-old child, otherwise...
